items.mainDefect: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim without stripping scheme/path, so migrated hosts never match record_for_host lookups.

secondary.defect: Host values are interpolated into the raw INSERT without SQL quoting, so a value containing an apostrophe breaks the statement.

items.mainDefect: update and destroy dereference EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first without a nil check, raising NoMethodError (500) instead of returning 404 for a missing id.

secondary.defect: save_host reads params[:embeddable_host][:host] without checking that the embeddable_host param exists, so it crashes when the payload is missing it.

items.mainDefect: The migration dereferences execute(...)[0]['id'] for embed_category without checking for zero rows, so db:migrate crashes on sites where the setting was never set.

secondary.defect: The `if category_id == 0` fallback to uncategorized_category_id is unreachable dead code.
The uncategorized_category_id query also dereferences [0]['value'] without checking that a row was returned.

items.mainDefect: The spec test name 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' describes behavior that was removed from expandable_first_post?, so the test is stale.
The migration dereferences [0]['id'] on the embed_category query without guarding for zero rows, so db:migrate aborts with NoMethodError.

secondary.defect: The query joins the setting value on the category name, but the old embed_category setting stored a category id, so it never matches.

items.mainDefect: In the plural _hydrateEmbedded branch, `hydrated || []` is dead code because .map always returns a truthy array.

secondary.defect: The plural branch keeps failed lookups as falsy entries and always deletes the original *_ids key, so the raw ids are lost when side-loaded records are missing.
obj[k].map throws a TypeError when a *_ids key holds null, which aborts hydration of the whole payload.

items.mainDefect: update and destroy use EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first without a presence check, raising NoMethodError (500) instead of returning 404 when no record matches.

secondary.defect: save_host assumes params[:embeddable_host] exists before reading [:host] and [:category_id].

items.mainDefect: The `if category_id == 0` fallback can never run because a zero-row embed_category query crashes on the nil [0] dereference first, and a matched id is never 0.

secondary.defect: The uncategorized_category_id lookup also dereferences the query result without checking that a row was returned.
